scope.summary: Implement placed graphics in graphic frames (StudioLayer of placed-asset kind). Picture frames of arbitrary shape (rectangle, ellipse, or any StudioVectorPath) MUST clip and fit placed content. Place options MUST be format-aware and enumerable: Layered raster (PSD-class: preserve layers/comps/transparency/channels, per-place layer visibility, RGB/CMYK/Lab/Grayscale); Vector/PDF-class (page selection, crop-to bounding-box/art/crop/trim/bleed/media, transparent background, multi-page load onto cursor); Flat raster (TIFF/JPEG/PNG-class: embedded clipping path, alpha-channel choice, per-image profile + rendering intent); Scalable vector (SVG-class); Nested layout document (page selection + layer-visibility overrides, tracked as link); Movie/sound interactive (poster frame, controller skin, play-on-load, loop, navigation points — authoring here, export via 14.11). Multi-file and gridified placement load multiple assets onto the cursor placed in sequence or as a grid. Pixel editing owned by 14.4.
acceptance_criteria: format-aware placement for all six classes + arbitrary-shape frames + multi-file/gridified placement
proof_targets: per-format place runtime; multi-file/gridified placement test
expected_tests: live: place each format class into an arbitrary-shape frame with its enumerated options (layered/vector-PDF/flat/SVG/nested-doc/media)
test: multi-file + gridified placement load onto cursor and place in sequence/grid

risk_if_missed: Cannot place images/graphics; layout documents cannot hold artwork.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
